description: Hi everyone! I'm a computer science student interested in technology, AI, innovation, and space exploration. I enjoy learning, problem-solving, and creating new ideas. I'm looking for enthusiastic team members with skills in programming, web development, UI/UX design, data analysis, research, and presentation. Beginners are welcome too! Let's share ideas, learn together, and build something creative and meaningful for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026!
summary:
Project Summary – Space Time Capsule

Space Time Capsule is a web-based project designed to preserve personal memories, thoughts, and meaningful messages for the future. It provides users with a digital platform to capture special moments and revisit them later. The main aim of the project is to create a simple, interactive, and user-friendly experience that connects the present with the future through digital memory preservation.

The website is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML provides the structure, CSS handles the design and layout, and JavaScript adds interactive functionality. The website is deployed using Netlify for online accessibility.

The project demonstrates how web technologies can be used creatively to preserve meaningful experiences. Future enhancements may include user authentication, cloud storage, image and video uploads, scheduled message delivery, and improved security.

Tagline: Preserve Today. Relive Tomorrow.
details:
Project Details – Space Time Capsule

Space Time Capsule is a web-based platform designed to help users preserve meaningful memories, personal thoughts, and messages for the future. It provides an interactive website where users can explore the concept of creating digital time capsules and preserving special moments. The platform aims to make memory preservation simple, engaging, and accessible.

The project is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML is used to structure the website, CSS provides its visual appearance and layout, and JavaScript adds interactive features. Netlify is used for hosting and deployment.

The main benefit of this project is that it encourages people to preserve important experiences rather than allowing them to be forgotten over time. Its intended impact is to create a meaningful connection between individuals and their past memories while encouraging creative use of technology.

The creative aspect of the project lies in transforming the traditional concept of a time capsule into a digital experience. During development, factors such as user-friendliness, visual appeal, accessibility, simplicity, and smooth navigation were considered.

Future improvements could include secure user accounts, cloud storage, multimedia uploads, and scheduled delivery of saved messages.
